summary: Phase A validated end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass on /app/backend/tests/test_phase_a.py — Residential assessment overview returns 6 sections with only first 'current' and rest 'locked'; GET locked slug -> 403; GET current -> 200 with prev/next slugs; PUT with completed_categories:['_'] and missing mandatory 'met' -> 400; plain draft PUT (no completed_categories) returns next_slug=None and does NOT unlock next section (subsequent GET water-conservation still 403); PUT with mandatory met + completed_categories:['_'] returns next_slug='water-conservation' and unlocks it (GET wc -> 200, GET ee -> still 403); admin /api/admin/portal/dashboard returns richer counts (clients, reviewers, projects, unassigned, under_review, changes_requested, awaiting_admin, certified). Commercial regression: overview slugs start with site-selection, energy-efficiency still 403 at start. Frontend: /admin/login -> after login, /admin (WorkspaceSwitcher rendered with data-testid=workspace-switcher + ws-website + ws-certification cards). Clicking ws-certification -> /admin/certification, cert-dashboard renders with all 8 stat cards (stat-clients=2, stat-reviewers=2, stat-projects=2, stat-unassigned=0, stat-under-review=0, stat-changes=0, stat-awaiting=0, stat-certified=0). Cert sidebar shows Portal Overview / All Projects / Clients / Reviewers with 'Switch Workspace' button (admin-switch-workspace). Website Management sidebar (Dashboard, Homepage, Services, Team, Blog, etc.) shown only after clicking ws-website. Client: /portal/projects/new -> Residential residential IGBC Green Homes project created; ProjectOverview page renders project-overview, project-timeline (Project Created event), overview-continue-btn, all 6 sections in stepper with Sustainable Design current and others 'Locked — complete previous section'. Direct URL to .../assessment/energy-efficiency redirects back to overview. Clicking Start assessment -> /portal/projects/:id/assessment/sustainable-design with assessment-section, autosave-status ('Auto-save on'), section-continue button, sticky sidebar summary (score + section stepper), Mandatory Requirements shown first (2 Met checkboxes) then Optional Credits (4 number inputs). Checking both Met + entering 2 pts + Save & Continue -> toast 'Section saved' and URL advances to .../assessment/water-conservation with stepper showing SD ✓ complete and WC current. Regression: Reviewer login works (welcome banner), public /events loads with mega-menu header, /admin website management preserved.

issues: After successful admin login, redirect goes directly to /admin/dashboard (Website Management) instead of the /admin workspace switcher. The switcher only appears when the user manually navigates to /admin or clicks 'Switch Workspace'. Spec says the landing /admin shows the switcher — currently the login flow bypasses it, so a returning admin who wants the Certification Portal must click Switch Workspace first. Consider redirecting to /admin on login.

action_items: (Optional polish) Redirect admins to /admin (workspace switcher) after login instead of /admin/dashboard so both workspaces are equally reachable on entry.

(Optional) The 'Total Projects' card on cert-dashboard doesn't yet act as a link/button to /admin/certification/projects — only the 'View all projects' CTA below the grid navigates. Spec suggested clicking a card should navigate; currently only View all projects does. Non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: portal.py save_assessment_section: 'proceed' signal is `bool(data.completed_categories)` — any non-empty list unlocks (including the sentinel ['_']). This is by design per contract but the sentinel is not documented in code; add a docstring/comment so future devs don't accidentally treat it as the actual list of completed slugs.

portal.py _section_states: state 'unlocked' (a previously-passed-but-not-marked-complete section) is exposed but the frontend appears to only differentiate complete/current/locked. Confirm intent — otherwise remove or fold into 'complete'.

rating_template.py CAT_SLUGS: 'Innovation and Decarbonisation' (Commercial) and 'Innovation and Design' (Residential) both share the last-position slug prefix 'innovation-' — currently different suffixes so no collision, but future templates should keep slugs globally unique to avoid ambiguity in the /assessment/:slug route.

AssessmentSection.jsx (per behavior observed): only 2 checkboxes rendered for Sustainable Design mandatory items — good. Ensure the frontend also sends {met: false} explicitly (rather than omitting the key) so partial saves don't leave stale prior 'met:true' when user unchecks. Not verified via network trace this run.
Frontend AdminLayout: after login the redirect target is hardcoded to /admin/dashboard rather than /admin — see design issue above.

portal.py has grown to ~770 lines with 22 route handlers; still under the 700 threshold flagged last iteration was breached slightly — consider extracting client-assessment routes into portal_client_assessment.py (get_assessment_overview / section GET+PUT) and reviewer/admin routes into portal_reviewer.py and portal_admin.py.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_phase_a.py (new — 8 pytest cases for sequential locking + admin cert dashboard)
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_PhaseA_Res_*, TEST_PhaseA_Com_*, TEST_UI_A_* certification projects for the test client during backend + frontend runs. Safe to leave or purge by TEST_ prefix.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend regression with: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<public-url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_phase_a.py /app/backend/tests/test_portal_phase2.py /app/backend/tests/test_portal.py -v -o addopts=''`. NOTE: cookies use COOKIE_SECURE=true so tests MUST hit the https public URL (not localhost:8001) or auth cookies won't stick. Sequential save-and-continue is signalled to the backend by putting a non-empty list in `completed_categories` (typically ['_']); a plain draft omits that key. Residential category slugs used in routes: sustainable-design, water-conservation, energy-efficiency, materials-resources, health-wellbeing, innovation-design. Commercial: site-selection, water-conservation, energy-efficiency, materials-resources, indoor-environmental-quality, innovation-decarbonisation. Client 'Create Project' final wizard button text is 'Create project' (lowercase p). Admin workspace switcher only renders at /admin exactly — after login the user is redirected to /admin/dashboard (see action item).
rca of the issue: N/A — all Phase-A features work as specified. Only nit: admin post-login redirect skips the workspace switcher (goes to /admin/dashboard instead of /admin).
